rawAnswer: {"story":{"what":"TypeCollector no longer indexes DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] when it builds the BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull and field MemberNeedsKey diagnostics. Instead it uses null-safe lookups, so a symbol from metadata (no syntax) yields a null location. The collector's report callback is now wrapped so that only diagnostics located in a syntax tree of the current compilation are forwarded. The analyzer now starts TypeCollector only for [MessagePackObject] classes, not structs. New tests compile a defining assembly to a metadata-only reference, run the analyzer and generator on a consuming project, and check that the resolver is generated with no warnings.
